E0981

The `jet os` config file doesn't exist.

What

The `jet os` config file doesn't exist.

Why

A bare host loads `./config.jet`; `host@root` loads `root/config.jet` when `root` is a directory, or the file named by `root`.

Fix

Create it with `jet os init <host>`, or pass an external root as `host@root`.
